{{Quote|I am Dray. This is my holocron. It was by my design that it comes to you. For what I know is meant for you and you alone.&hellip;|Dray's holocron to Finn Galfridian|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 1" />}}
'''Dray's holocron''' was created by [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]] sometime before or during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The holocron contained information about [[Yuuzhan Vong]] infiltrators wearing [[ooglith masquer]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 4">[[Invasion 4|''Invasion'' 4]]</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], her [[Solo family/Legends|children]], [[Lowbacca]], and [[Finn Galfridian]] traveled to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to acquire this information from an unknown [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], later revealed as [[Spraug]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" />

After the acquisition they found the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] would show only one Yuuzhan Vong infiltrator: [[Dulac]], a person Finn had known on [[Artorias]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" /> On [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] learned the holocron only worked in the vicinity of Finn and deduced the holocron was meant for him. This was later confirmed when Finn was alone and held the holocron, Dray appeared to him and warned him of a revelation about one close to him and [[Tsalok]] hunting him. Dray also told Finn he had to go back to Artorias, although he did not know why.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Invasion 0]] the holocron is shaped like a [[Wikipedia:icosidodecahedron|icosidodecahedron]], but when it reappears in [[Invasion 5]] it is shaped like a pyramid. All subsequent appearances use the pyramid shape.
